notes: Interaction discipline, matching the installer (from field use: the builder was too verbose): it now narrates progress as it works in short lines, asks every decision ONE at a time — the fidelity choice, approval of each proposed question, each privacy item, each declaration topic — presents findings as information separately from decisions, and keeps reports to the headline with full detail in the creation record. Also includes the pack-folder naming change and interim ibuildwith.ai/skills endpoints (0.1.1).
